sources: https://www.kliaekspres.com/media/rojb45mf/kt-train-schedule_effective-21-mar-2026.pdf (retrieved 2026-09-28): KLIA Transit service schedule effective 21 March 2026, weekday and weekend/public-holiday departures for every station.
